# p10k-rs v0.2.3

**The "`p10k-rs doctor` + Windows release matrix" release.** New
runtime diagnostic subcommand surfaces fresh-install snags as
structured checks; the release pipeline grows Windows MSVC targets
to unblock the long-pending Scoop manifest.

**Test count:** +76 over v0.2.2 (workspace total: **655**).
**Commits:** 7.
**Theme:** "diagnostics + Windows."

## What you'll notice (visible changes)

### `p10k-rs doctor [--json]`

Nine probes against the environmental snags users hit on a fresh
install. Each reports `OK` / `WARN` / `ERROR` / `SKIP`; exit code is
the aggregated worst severity (`0` / `1` / `2`).

```sh
$ p10k-rs doctor
[OK   ] gitstatusd_binary: found at /usr/local/bin/gitstatusd
[WARN ] shell_init_sourced: no `_P10K_RS_GITSTATUSD_*` env vars — run `eval "$(p10k-rs init zsh)"` from your shell rc
[SKIP ] osc7_supported: TERM_PROGRAM not set; cannot infer terminal capabilities
doctor: warnings present (exit 1)
```

Checks:

| Name | Probes |
|---|---|
| `nerd_font_glyphs` | UTF-8 locale + WSL gate |
| `gitstatusd_binary` | matches the prompt's lookup path |
| `gitstatusd_version_pin` | bundled sha256 pins vs. installed binary |
| `config_file_present` | XDG / `$P10K_RS_CONFIG` / `~/.config/p10k-rs/config.toml` |
| `config_file_parses` | schema-validate the resolved file |
| `shell_init_sourced` | `_P10K_RS_GITSTATUSD_*` env vars |
| `instant_prompt_cache_writable` | `~/.cache/p10k-rs` perms |
| `osc7_supported` | `$TERM_PROGRAM` known-good list |
| `wsl_windows_font_warning` | WSL + Windows-side font gap |

`--json` emits a `p10krs.doctor/v1` envelope for scripts — fourth
diagnostic subcommand to join the JSON family started in v0.1.10
(`daemon-health --json`):

```sh
$ p10k-rs doctor --json | jq '.checks[] | select(.status=="ERROR")'
```

### Windows release matrix

The release workflow now builds `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` and
`aarch64-pc-windows-msvc` alongside the existing four linux + macOS
targets. Both Windows arches build on `windows-latest`; aarch64
cross-compiles cleanly via `rustup target add` without an external
toolchain.

Windows archives ship as `.zip` (PowerShell `Compress-Archive`)
with matching `.zip.sha256` sidecars in the standard
`<hex>  <file>\n` format. Sigstore signing + provenance attestation
fire on the Windows artifacts identically to the unix ones.

This unblocks the Scoop manifest scaffold that's been sitting in
`packaging/scoop/p10k-rs.json` since the v0.2 cycle opened.

### Per-segment mdBook pages

The user guide gains 14 dedicated pages under
`mdBook → Segments`: `ai_host`, `ai_status`, `anaconda`, `aws`,
`background_jobs`, `command_execution_time`, `context`, `dir`,
`docker_context`, `fnm`, `jj`, `kubecontext`, `mise`,
`node_version`. Each page covers render shape, per-state palette,
config schema, and segment-specific gotchas.

The remaining six (`vcs`, `virtualenv`, `pyenv`, `nodenv`, `pixi`,
`root_indicator`) plus `troubleshooting` land in a follow-up
cycle; pages already in this release link to them as the future
home.

## Internals

### Bug fixes

- **Build break** on `main`. Warp first-class detection commit missed
  a wildcard arm on the `#[non_exhaustive] HostKind` match.
- **`cargo doc -D warnings`** restored. Four broken intra-doc links
  from the v0.2 commits (three private-item links in `ai_status.rs`,
  one unresolved field link in `prompt_json.rs`).
- **`cargo clippy -D warnings`** restored. 11 lints across
  `p10k-rs-ai`, `p10k-rs-segments`, and `p10k-rs` — pattern matching,
  doc backticks, manual let-else, format-push-string, and friends.

All three regressions sat on `main` because piped gate-check
invocations (`cargo X | tail`) were masking cargo's exit code
(STATE.md gotcha #1). Caught at v0.2.3 cut time.

### `bench/compare_criterion.sh`

Baseline-vs-current criterion diff. Joins the existing manual bench
harness (`aggregate.sh` / `run_baseline.sh` / `fetch_fixtures.sh`).
Thresholds via env (`PERF_WARN_PCT` default 10, `PERF_FAIL_PCT`
default 25); exit codes 0/1/2. `bash 4+` + `awk`; no `jq` dep. Not
wired into any workflow — standalone tool.

## Compatibility

- **Wire compatibility:** preserved across `daemon-health --json` /
  `version --json` / `verify --json` / `doctor --json`. All four
  diagnostic surfaces follow the same additive-evolution discipline.
- **Schema:** no changes to `config.toml`. Bundled themes unchanged
  byte-for-byte.
- **Architecture:** load-bearing invariants (`SafeText` chokepoint,
  spawn-per-prompt sync, `unsafe` budget in `p10k-rs-git` only)
  unchanged.
- **Toolchain:** Rust 1.88 (unchanged).

## Verification

```sh
p10k-rs --version          # 0.2.3
p10k-rs verify             # gitstatusd sha256 vs. bundled pin
p10k-rs doctor             # new: nine-check environmental probe
gh attestation verify p10k-rs-0.2.3-<triple>.tar.gz --repo scurran1986/powerlevel10k-rs
```

Windows users on the v0.2.3 release page get `.zip` archives plus
matching `.zip.sha256` sidecars; verify with
`Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256` or `sha256sum -c` from WSL / Git
Bash.
